summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests RYZ401, a radiopharmaceutical labeled with actinium-225, in neuroendocrine tumors and other solid tumors that express somatostatin receptors. How the drug is given, and how often, is not stated in the record. The main goals are to find the recommended Phase 2 dose and best treatment schedule, to assess safety and tolerability, and to evaluate early signs of effect.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa RYZ401, un radiofármaco marcado con actinio-225, en tumores neuroendocrinos y otros tumores sólidos que expresan receptores de somatostatina. La forma de administración y la frecuencia no se indican en el registro. Los objetivos principales son determinar la dosis recomendada para la Fase 2 y el mejor esquema de tratamiento, evaluar la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y estudiar los primeros signos de efecto.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older at consent.
Histologically confirmed grade 1-3 well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor, metastatic or unresectable, from any primary site (dose escalation).
Expansion cohort A: grade 1-3 gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, metastatic or unresectable.
Expansion cohort B: certain non-GI/pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors or grade 1-3 meningioma, SSTR-positive on SSTR-PET imaging.
Adequate renal, hematologic and hepatic function (cohort B).
not_for: Prior solid organ or bone marrow transplant.
Use of chronic systemic steroid therapy.
Significant cardiovascular disease, resistant hypertension, or uncontrolled diabetes.
Prior liver cirrhosis, HIV, hepatitis B, or known active hepatitis C.
